title: Spectral width and polynomial degree in perfect state transfer
summary: We study the minimum time for perfect state transfer under polynomial Hamiltonians with bounded degree and spectral width. For a strongly cospectral pair and width bound $W$, the optimum, when finite, is an integer multiple of $π/W$, determined by integer interpolation with prescribed parities. For equally spaced supported eigenvalues with alternating signs, we give degree bounds under which every minimizer is affine, and sharp asymptotics for each fixed exact degree.
